forward: Run named exhaustive, boundary and metamorphic tests; each successful test is conjunction of its explicit Rust assertions. The suite executes production methods directly and independent reference predicates.
inverse: For fixed finite fixtures, U consists of candidate terminating implementations paired with claimed pass/fail outcomes. R pairs each with conjunction of actual assertions. U minus R contains false pass and false failure claims. Unexercised inputs are unconstrained; a passing suite is not universal correctness.

A passing transcript admits every implementation satisfying the finite assertions, including implementations wrong outside the observed domain. A failing assertion restricts antecedents to implementations violating that exact predicate, without uniquely locating the defect.
limitations: Finite evidence is not proof; allocation failures outside Result; partial syntax only; no executable lossy approximants.
